top_band: greyish-blue metal top surface with vent detail (rows 0-5) and bright pink front edge (row 6)
evidence: Rows 0-5 show a 6px foreshortened grey top plane with a dark vent slot (rows 2-3), followed by a 1px bright pink front edge line at row 6, a 1px dark purple eave shadow at row 7, and the magenta front face with recessed display window and dispensing slot at rows 8-30.

style.evidence: While the 3/4 geometry is clear, the magenta casing (rows 8-28), cyan shelf backgrounds, and dark borders are mostly flat solid fills with only 3 shading steps on the main body (light pink highlight, mid magenta fill, dark purple border/shadow) and almost no surface grain or subtle shading variations compared to the richly textured wood and stone of the Beodeul references.
